message:
I remember the time we had a sudden power outage right during dinner prep. I was juggling pots and pans, and just as I reached for my trusty recipe app, my phone blinked off — battery dead! Talk about a scramble. I quickly grabbed my power bank and some flashlights, and while it wasn’t gourmet, we ended up with a lovely candlelit dinner featuring whatever we could whip up with just the ingredients on hand. 

That evening reminded me how important it is to keep tech charged and have a backup plan ready. I now make it a habit to check my devices and keep them powered up, just in case. 

What’s your go-to trick for staying comfortable during a blackout?
